chunks: 6 – Al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamza, client of the Anṣār, Abū Muḥammad. Wāqif ibn Wāqif. He is weak in himself, and his father is more trustworthy than him. And Al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Faḍḍāl said: I fear God that I should narrate from Al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī. And the ḥadīth of al-Riḍā (peace be upon him) regarding him is famous.
ai.seo_question: Who is Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abi Hamza and what is his status in hadith sciences?
ai.summary: This biographical entry discusses the narrator Al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamza (also known as Wāqif ibn Wāqif), noting his weakness in hadith transmission compared to his father. It cites Al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Faḍḍāl's hesitation to narrate from him due to this weakness, while acknowledging that his narration of the ḥadīth of al-Riḍā (peace be upon him) is well-known.
